item.title: [ Mod ] [FN: Rearousal] Frenni Fazclaire (Coach)
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
"Welcome to Fazclaire's! Party, dance, or kick back with our next-level cyborg idols late into the night. Our mind-blowing personalities will leave you with an unforgettable experience! Fazclaire ENT is not liable for a missing person or death. Adults only. Please drink and party responsibly." I’d like to clarify that I did not create the mod and the model port myself. The model port and the VGUI icons (Lobby, Panel, and Incap) were created by another person who preferred to remain anonymous. This was a commissioned mod, which he kindly helped with the port of the model and the creation of the icons for said commission, also he gave me permission to upload the mod to the Steam Workshop so it can be shared with everyone. I want to give him my sincere thanks for his work. Also, in case you wonder what's up with the name of FN: Rearousal (Fazclaire's Nightclub: The Rearousal), It's the official name that CryptiaCurves gave for the redesigned version of her Fazclaire's Nightclub models. Features: - World Model - FP Arms - Facial Flexes - Jiggle Bones - Bile Texture - Custom HUD - Custom Attachments - Rochelle's animations Original model by: CryptiaCurves You can buy the models at cryptiacurves.itch.io If you find problems in the mod, feel free to tell me about them in the comments.

item.title: [ Mod ] Lima Infection: Special Infected
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
Description Lima Infection: Special Infected is a custom character pack for Left 4 Dead 2, developed by Amauta Collective. It replaces all Special Infected from Left 4 Dead and Left 4 Dead 2 with designs inspired by public figures, characters, and popular references from Peruvian culture and internet culture. This addon is completely optional and is not required to play the Lima Infection campaign. It is intended for players who wish to use these characters and further immerse themselves in the mod’s universe. Compatibility This addon may conflict with other mods that replace the same Special Infected, sounds, music, or HUD elements. Disable conflicting addons before playing. item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Amid The Ruins
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
A Sequel To Dead South "After spending the night sailing down the savannah river, the survivors wake up to the Captain turning infected causing the boat to crash in Jasper County, with no immediate goal the survivors must venture forward into the unknown." Fight your way though Trailer Parks, Warehouses, Towns And a Power Plant, in this five-chapter Campaign taking place in Jasper County, SC It supports Singleplayer, Co-op, Versus, And Survival. Console Names: atr01_trailer_park atr02_outskirts atr03_town atr04_power_station atr05_plant Credits: Hsyenoh05 - Skybox for chapters 1-3 & 4, TM1566 - Color Correction for chapters 4-5, CastorJudo - Various Metal Textures The Rabbit - Frosted Glass Texture Royal Blood - Radio Song Play Testers - Warhawk, Konsta Starlight

item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Dead Flag Blues 2 Reborn
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
A complete remake of Dead Flag Blues, a custom campaign back from the original Left 4 Dead! Created by Juxtapox and then later ported to Left 4 Dead 2 by Gemini Saga, blended elements from both the original and the port to make this modern rendition. Every map has been reconstructed from the ground up, and made a few level design and gameplay changes to the campaign to give it more of a vanilla "Valve" feel
